_meta.note: Server-sent text. Same standing as app/i18n/ha.json — a language-model draft on top of a glossary one anonymous Hausa speaker checked. Nobody has read these.
_meta.smsNote: Every hooked letter here (ɓ ɗ ƙ) is outside GSM-7, so any of these sent as SMS costs UCS-2 segments — 70 characters each instead of 160. That is the right trade; see smsSegments() in services/i18n.js.
